entries.name: Stamp duty on conveyances and other assignments of property other than financial instruments (1 % of the consideration)
entries.statute: Stamp Duty Act Cap. 274 Schedule A, Conveyance Section, paragraph (i) as amended by the Finance Act 2024 s. 2 (in force 1 January 2024; the Finance Act 2023 s. 2 had set 2 %); Finance Acts 2025 and 2026 read: no stamp duty change (R4 world copies world/B10-anglophone-africa/sl/law/The_Finance_Act_2024_0d6d83e684.txt). The Act Cap. 274 itself (charging and liability sections) not held: B. Liability: charged on the purchaser (grantee) as the model's buyer; not verified in Cap. 274
entries.doc: Finance Act 2024 s. 2: 'Stamp Duty Fees for conveyances and other assignments of property, real and personal, mortgages debentures and transfers thereof, and liquidations, of the value of the property: 0.01 or 1% of consideration for properties other than financial instruments; 0.002 or 0.2% of consideration for financial instruments'. Fifteenth pass.
unsupported: financial instruments 0,2 % (share transfers): no purchase kind for shares in this family
mortgages and debentures at the same rate
the party liable under Cap. 274 not read (flag)

entries.name: Final withholding tax on dividends paid to residents (15 %)
entries.statute: Income Tax Act 2000 (as amended to FA 2017) s. 118, 124; First Schedule Part IV as replaced by the Finance Act 2024 (FA 2018-2023 and FA 2025 checked: s. 118, 124 not amended)
entries.doc: s. 118(1)(a): a resident company paying a dividend to a resident withholds at the First Schedule Part IV rate; FA 2024 Part IV: dividends 15 %, interest 15 %, rents 10 %; s. 124: the tax withheld under s. 118 and 119 is final (not aggregated, no refund).
unsupported: dividends to resident companies and complying retirement funds are outside (s. 118(2))

entries.name: Final withholding tax on interest paid to residents (15 %)
entries.statute: Income Tax Act 2000 s. 119, 124; First Schedule Part IV (Finance Act 2024)
entries.doc: s. 119(1)(a): a resident paying interest to a resident withholds at the Part IV rate (15 %, FA 2024); s. 124 (heading 'dividend and interest payments to residents') makes it final — its body speaks of 'a dividend payment ... under sections 118 and 119', hence B.
unsupported: interest paid to resident banks and on Government Development Stocks is outside (s. 119(2))

entries.name: NASSIT employer contribution (10 %)
entries.statute: NASSIT, page 'Contributions' (nassit.org.sl, fetched 2026-11-21, R4/fetch/sl11); National Social Security and Insurance Trust Act 2001 not read
entries.doc: NASSIT states that the employer deducts 5 % of an employee's monthly earnings as the employee's contribution and adds 10 % of those earnings as its own, 15 % in all.
